name: Bahia Principe Explore Tulum

kids_club.evidence: Bahia Scouts is included for ages 4-12, based in the Zama kids' area with Maya-themed play. 2026 reviewers repeatedly rate it the best kids' club they have used: crafts, piñatas, water-park time, supervised lunch, kids on stage in evening shows. Hours are not published (about 9am-5pm per traveller reports).

water_play.evidence: Tulum has its own kids' water park with height-gated slides (two winding, one straight, kids only), bumper boats, a lazy river and a kids' pool, plus a large three-level main pool.

beach.evidence: It has the longest beachfront in the complex, but the hotel itself warns the restored beach erodes daily and changes width; sandbags line parts of the shore. Waves can be choppy for small kids, and this open-coast stretch takes heavy seaweed in spring despite daily cleaning.

rooms.evidence: Junior suites have 2 double beds (or a king) and sleep 3 adults plus a child; Family Suites (bedroom plus living room) and 2-bedroom suites with two bathrooms are available. The family area is a 5-10 min walk from the lobby. Unverified whether connecting rooms exist.

food.evidence: Four à la carte restaurants (Indian, gourmet, Brazilian, Mexican) plus a buffet and snack bars, with exchange dinners at Coba and Akumal. They are capped at 3 bookings a week, and the buffet closed for dinner two nights a week through Oct 2026. The Brazilian churrascaria is meat-heavy; Indian and Mexican add variety.

transfer.evidence: 96 km from CUN; about 90 min by private van. TQO is about 64 km and roughly an hour away but has fewer international nonstops than CUN.

condition.evidence: Fully refurbished in 2020 with new pools and room categories, and newer water slides added since. 2026 reviews describe well-kept grounds and spacious rooms. No 2026-27 renovation is announced here.

kids_club.name: Bahia Scouts (Zama Kids Zone) + Teens Club
kids_club.hours: not published; about 9am-5pm plus evening shows per traveller reports (unverified)
kids_club.notes: The club runs water-park sessions twice a day and takes kids to lunch. The shared Hacienda Doña Isabel hosts kids' carnival nights.

pros: 2026 families rate the kids' club the best they have used
Slide water park, lazy river and kids' pool on site
Indian and Mexican à la carte restaurants add variety
cons: The hotel warns its beach erodes daily; sandbags line parts of the shore
Open-coast beach takes heavy sargassum from spring
Only 3 à la carte dinners a week
Family rooms are a 5-10 min walk from the lobby
verdict: Strongest kids' club and water play in the Bahia Principe complex, but families should expect an eroded, seaweed-prone beach in late April.
